app.name: Veiltrium
login.title: Panel password
login.hint: Forgot it? On the server: bash veiltrium.sh --panel-password
login.note: Reached through your SSH tunnel; the panel never listens on a public address.
ov.title: Overview
ov.ruNoAnswer: Globalping did not answer; the last result is kept. Try again later.
ov.ruBlockedNote: No Russian network reaches this address: ask the hoster for another IP.
ov.ruStreak: Not reachable in {n} checks in a row. Consider moving the node (veiltrium export / import) or a standby address.
ov.homeStalled: transfers freeze after a few KB (TSPU cut-off)
ov.auditFailed: The action log could not be loaded.
ov.firewallMissing: The firewall rules are not loaded
ov.scannersValue: {n} networks see only SSH · refreshed weekly
ov.sshValue: Password login kept · attempt limits, PerSourcePenalties, fail2ban {f2b}
ov.proxiesValue: Separate users, systemd sandbox, no access to the server itself or private networks
ov.updatesValue: Security updates install automatically; a reboot happens in the night window
cl.title: Clients
cl.subtitle: Each client has its own credentials on all three protocols. Revoking one never affects the others.
cl.select: Choose a client to see its links.
cl.qrTooLong: This link is too long for a QR code; copy it instead.
cl.awgNote: AWG Manager: add VLESS and TrustTunnel as a single server from the link; Hysteria as a server group from the JSON (it keeps the key pinning).
cl.standbyHint: Same account on {servers}; use these links as a fallback if the main address is blocked.
cl.imp.title: Import to apps
cl.imp.disabled: The client is disabled — no import data.
cl.imp.subHint: For v2rayNG, v2rayN, Happ: add a subscription from the clipboard.
cl.imp.profileHint: For Hiddify, NekoBox, Karing, sing-box SFA/SFI: import from the clipboard or a file. The Hysteria certificate pin is checked.
cl.imp.h1: sing-box based apps (Hiddify, NekoBox, Karing, SFA, SFI): use the sing-box profile.
cl.imp.h2: Xray based apps (v2rayNG, v2rayN, Happ): use the subscription. Support for the Hysteria pin varies, so prefer VLESS Reality.
cl.imp.h3: Keenetic router (AWG Manager): VLESS and TrustTunnel by link, Hysteria through the server group JSON.
cl.imp.h4: Phones: if the connection degrades after a few minutes in VPN (TUN) mode, try proxy mode or turn off sniffing.
cl.imp.h5: Reality: set fingerprint chrome and keep TCP Fast Open off.
reset.title: Reset credentials of {name}?
reset.text: New passwords and keys are created on all three protocols. The old links and configs of {name} stop working at once, and the new ones must be sent to the person who uses them. Other clients are not affected.
reset.done: Credentials of {name} reset: send the new links
reset.failed: Not reset: {reason}. The previous credentials were kept.
add.title: Add client
add.name: Name
add.note: The three services restart: connected clients reconnect within a few seconds. Real clients check the result; on any failure the previous settings come back.
add.failed: Not added: {reason}. The previous settings were kept.
add.mainChanged: The main client's Hysteria link changed (password per client now): update it on its devices.
rm.title: Revoke {name}?
rm.text: Its Hysteria, VLESS and TrustTunnel credentials stop working at once, on every device that uses them. Other clients keep working; connected ones reconnect within seconds.
lim.why.quota: The traffic limit is used up. Raise it or wait for the counter to reset, then enable the client.
lim.why.expired: The expiry date has passed. Set a new date, then enable the client.
lim.why.manual: Disabled by you: its links do not work until you enable it.
lim.title: Limits
lim.noLimits: No limits: traffic, expiry and counter reset are not restricted.
lim.fieldLimitHint: Leave empty for no limit. Decimal units: 1 GB = 1000 MB.
lim.errLimit: Enter a positive number, at most 1 PB.
lim.fieldExpiryHint: Leave empty for no expiry. The client works through this whole day (UTC).
lim.pastWarn: This date has passed: the client will be disabled right away.
lim.fieldResetHint: When traffic counting starts again from zero (UTC; weekly: Monday, monthly: the 1st).
lim.editNote: If the client's state changes, the three services restart and are checked with real clients; on any error the previous settings come back.
lim.saveFailed: Not saved: {reason}. The previous settings are kept.
lim.disableText: The links and configs of {name} stop working right away in all three protocols, on every device. The client is kept, and you can enable it again at any time. Other clients are not affected.
lim.enableText: The links and configs of {name} work again. If the traffic limit is used up or the expiry date has passed, the server refuses: raise the limit or set a new date first.
